post.summary: Ensure the caller's personal tenant exists and is complete
post.description: Creates the caller's personal tenant on first call and completes its membership, owner role, grants and binding on every call. The tenant identifier and alias are derived from the account identifier; the answer names the tenant and whether this call created it.

200.description: The personal tenant, complete; created says whether this call registered it

403.description: The caller is impersonating, or is a static-table subject that cannot own a tenant

409.description: The caller already belongs to a tenant other than its personal one

503.description: A dependency could not answer; no part of the result is returned

created.description: Whether this call registered the tenant

alias.description: The request-surface name, equal to the identifier for a personal tenant

kind.description: The tenant kind; the frontend renders the personal label from it
